segments.t: At a Parisian cafe table, Andrea Martel sits down across from her former mentor and rival Mathias Barneville, now acting as an independent producer. Expecting a fair deal for Fabrice Luchini and rising talent Sofia Leprince, Andrea is outraged by Mathias's drastically low financial offer. When Mathias coldly threatens to poison ASK's relationship with star client Dany Boon unless she capitulates, a ruthless power struggle erupts. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Cette proposition financière est une mauvaise blague.
Tu renverrais un producteur avec cette offre.
Nous parlons de Fabrice Luchini ici.
Et nous parlons aussi de Sofia Leprince.
Ajoute un zéro à tous ces montants.
Tu acceptes cette offre telle quelle.
Sinon, je préviens Dany Boon immédiatement.
Je lui dirai qu'ASK manque d'avenir.
C'est vraiment un sale coup bas!
Ce n'est absolument rien de personnel.
C'est simplement la réalité du métier.
Diriger implique de perdre certaines batailles.
Je ne me laisserai jamais intimider.
Réfléchis bien à l'intérêt de l'agence.
Let's observe as Andrea and Mathias clash over contracts and agency loyalty.
Cette proposition financière est une mauvaise blague.
'This financial proposal is a bad joke.' The adjective meaning 'financial' takes its feminine form here to match the noun it describes.
Tu renverrais un producteur avec cette offre.

'You would send a producer packing with this offer.' A sharp comparison turning his own past agent standards against him. Notice how 'would send packing' leads directly into the noun meaning 'movie financier'.
Nous parlons de Fabrice Luchini ici.
'We are talking about Fabrice Luchini here.' The clause hinges on the everyday verb meaning 'talk'.
Et nous parlons aussi de Sofia Leprince.
'And we are also talking about Sofia Leprince.' A shrewd counter-argument pointing to the unproven newcomer co-star. The clause hinges on the everyday verb meaning 'talk'.
Ajoute un zéro à tous ces montants.
'Add a zero to all these amounts.' An aggressive counter-demand insisting on a tenfold increase in fees. The verb meaning 'add' pairs naturally with the noun for 'zero' in everyday conversation.
Tu acceptes cette offre telle quelle.
'You accept this offer as is.' An uncompromising ultimatum rejecting any further discussion on price. The adjective meaning 'such' takes its feminine form here to match the noun it describes.
Sinon, je préviens Dany Boon immédiatement.
'Otherwise, I notify Dany Boon immediately.' A ruthless threat turning private client trust into extortion. The clause hinges on the everyday verb meaning 'notify'.
Je lui dirai qu'ASK manque d'avenir.
'I will tell him ASK lacks a future.' A damaging weapon aimed directly at undermining client confidence. Notice how 'will tell' leads directly into the noun meaning 'future'.
C'est vraiment un sale coup bas!

'That is really a dirty low blow!' An outraged condemnation of unethical betrayal by a former partner. Notice how the short vowel drops before a vowel sound around 'it is', making the phrase flow smoothly as one unit.
Ce n'est absolument rien de personnel.

'This is absolutely nothing personal.' A cynical disavowal detaching private sentiment from commercial aggression. Notice how the short vowel drops before a vowel sound around 'is not', making the phrase flow smoothly as one unit.
C'est simplement la réalité du métier.
'It is simply the reality of the business.' The verb meaning 'it is' pairs naturally with the noun for 'reality' in everyday conversation.
Diriger implique de perdre certaines batailles.
'Leading implies losing certain battles.' A patronizing lesson instructing his successor on executive pragmatism. Notice how 'to lead' leads directly into the noun meaning 'battles'.
Je ne me laisserai jamais intimider.
'I will never let myself be intimidated.' The reflexive pronoun sits right in front of the verb for 'will let', turning the action back onto the subject.
Réfléchis bien à l'intérêt de l'agence.

'Think carefully about the agency's interest.' A calculated parting shot advising surrender for corporate survival. Notice how 'think' leads directly into the noun meaning 'interest'. Now let's listen to Andrea and Mathias negotiating again at full speed.

Refusing to bow to Mathias's blackmail, Andrea leaves the meeting with renewed anger and determination. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'proposal' and 'financial'. You'll catch them now. See you next time.
La guerre ne fait que commencer.
